test.create_query: CREATE TABLE codec_alp_small_blocks_{seq_type} (n Float64 CODEC(ALP, ZSTD(3))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity = 256, index_granularity_bytes = '10Mi', min_bytes_for_wide_part = '1Gi', parts_to_delay_insert = 5000, parts_to_throw_insert = 5000, auto_statistics_types = '';
test.query: INSERT INTO codec_alp_small_blocks_rtn (n) SELECT round(number / 20 + sin(number), 3) FROM system.numbers LIMIT 2000000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1
INSERT INTO codec_alp_small_blocks_rnd (n) SELECT (intHash64(number) - 4294967295) / pi() FROM system.numbers LIMIT 2000000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1
